profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Color

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed virtual card number features available in Capital One’s Android mobile application

positions.title: Undergrad Researcher
positions.description:
- Worked with Cardiac Biomechanics Lab @San Francisco VA Medical Center to prototype a novel device that deforms an MRI gel phantom for cardiovascular research
- Analyzed MRI scan data using MATLAB and LS-PrePost to extract displacement and strain values for cardiac deformation
- Submitted abstract & presented at BMES 2020 Annual Meeting

positions.title: UC Berkeley Representative @ Coulter College Design Competition
positions.description:
BMES Coulter College Design Competition serves to address real-life challenges in medicine.
- Developed a community health solution to medication compliance in hypertensive patients using the engineering design process

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Designed, built, and tested the interface of an Android mobile SDK that intuitively manages Capital One's virtual card number technology
- Mocked asynchronous API calls and prototyped a mobile app to display the usage of SDK in Kotlin through Android Studio

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
MyHealthTeams creates social networks for communities facing chronic conditions. 
- Worked with a small group of engineers to maintain and develop web/mobile applications. 
- Specifically worked with Rails/MongoDB to build web application features that optimize and automate select user behaviors.
